current_task_corrections.correction: Remove billed_amount and allowed_amount from the feature_set component's features parameter. Use only submission-time features: claim_type, cpt_category, place_of_service, provider_specialty, network_status, service_units, length_of_stay, er_flag, elective_flag, preventive_flag, auth_required_flag, primary_icd10_cm, drg_present.

The suspiciously high ROC-AUC (0.996-0.997) is a direct symptom of target leakage from including billed_amount and allowed_amount. Removing these leakage fields will naturally bring ROC-AUC into expected range [0.6, 0.95].
Add model_limitations to the write_report component's caveats parameter. Change caveats from ["small_groups", "class_imbalance"] to ["small_groups", "class_imbalance", "model_limitations"].
